data_sources: lolesports.com persisted gateway: getSchedule (results + schedule), getTeams (official rosters), getEventDetails (game sides)
gol.gg: pro game pages (patch, bans/picks, lineups, KDA) and per-patch champion statistics
Riot Data Dragon: champion tags (AP/AD, tank)

params.headline: ratings
params.headline_simulator: ratings-only (sim_r: rating_sd 0.35, map_sd 0.25, no side/draft term); draft sims are an informational panel
fitted: outcome_model side/draft coefficients (ridge MLE; continuity term only in v2)

draft_sim.note: INFORMATIONAL ONLY: draft-path simulation; not the lock, not graded, not used for edge

adversarial_review: Fearless: later-game drafts depend on earlier picks; G2/G3 draft trees are wide (top-draft probabilities are small)
Draft score is capped at +/-0.45 logit and regularised; drafts move map odds modestly by design
Lineups inferred from official roster + latest pro games (Leaguepedia unavailable/rate-limited)
